notes.title: OVR Input Method Bridge v0.2.2 Update Log
notes.content: [h2]Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Sogou Pinyin input method could not switch between Chinese and English in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the program could not run normally in multi-GPU environments, such as on laptops.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect button responses when two controller pointers were simultaneously over the candidate word list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where clicking the keyboard would cause the VRChat input box to lose focus when using the Knuckles controller. This fix was implemented by modifying the default controller binding for the Knuckles controller. Users who have custom controller bindings will need to revert to the default controller binding.[/p][/*][*][p]Restricted the virtual keyboard's roll angle; it will now automatically align to multiples of a specific angle.[/p][/*][*][p]Added default controller binding support for Pico controllers (double-tap 'A' to toggle the keyboard).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: OVR Input Method Bridge v0.2.1 Update Log
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the candidate word list could not be read in some cases when using the Microsoft Pinyin input method.
[*] Fixed an issue where the frame rate dropped in some cases when inputting with the Microsoft Pinyin input method.
[*] Fixed an issue where the input method automatically switched to the first one when the input method selection box was expanded.
[/list]

notes.title: OVR Input Method Bridge v0.2.0 Update Log
notes.content:
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Microsoft Pinyin IME Support
[/list]
[h2]Important Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Change the default keybindings for toggling the keyboard on the knuckles controller to double-press the right thumbsticks.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes and improvments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Slightly optimized the performance of the main window.
[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes not able to switch IME.
[*] Added a function to stop logging window messages. By default, logging window messages is disabled.
[*] Added a function to create a full core dump with hotkeys. The hotkey is Ctrl+Alt+Shift+NumPad/.
[/list]

notes.title: OVR Input Method Bridge v0.1.2 Update
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:​​[/h3]

[list]
[*] Auto-run with administrator privileges (no manual permission popups)
[*] Program is now able to minimizes to system tray
[*] Smoother keyboard overlay experience with multi-threaded window capture (higher FPS)
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed some bugs about keyboard interaction.
[/olist]
